title: Ghost Tour - Haunted Double Decker Bus
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the chilling stories of Houston’s haunted past on the only double-decker bus tour of its kind. As night falls, journey through the city’s darkest corners and uncover the legends that linger in forgotten cemeteries and haunted landmarks. Each stop unveils eerie tales, including ghostly echoes from the historic Rice Hotel and the haunted banks of Buffalo Bayou, ensuring a spine-tingling adventure for those fascinated by the supernatural.

- Unique open-top bus tour exploring Houston’s haunted sites
- Visit eerie locations like forgotten cemeteries and the Rice Hotel
- Learn about ghostly legends and local folklore from knowledgeable guides
- Perfect for thrill-seekers and paranormal enthusiasts alike
